name: MonarchPlanCard
title: PlanCard
summary: One plan in a plan picker: its name, price, who it is for, what it includes and a call to action, on a Monarch card.
whenToUse: In a plan picker or an upgrade screen, one card per plan, with the current plan marked.
whenNotToUse: For usage against the limits of the current plan use MonarchUsageMeter. The card never starts a purchase by itself: the action must use Google Play Billing for digital goods.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPlanCard(name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, price: String? = null, period: String? = null, priceNote: String? = null, description: String? = null, featuresLabel: String? = null, features: List<MonarchPlanCardFeature> = emptyList(), badge: String? = null, footer: String? = null, highlighted: Boolean = false, current: Boolean = false, includedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, currentPlanLabel: String? = null, notIncludedLabel: String? = null, action: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchPlanCardFeature(label: String, hint: String? = null, included: Boolean = true)

options.name: name
options.description: The plan name, already localised. A heading.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the card. The card fills the available width.

options.name: price
options.description: The price as the product writes it, such as "$12" or "Contact us". Never formatted by the card.

options.name: period
options.description: Text after the price, such as "per seat / month".

options.name: priceNote
options.description: A line under the price, such as "Billed yearly".

options.name: description
options.description: One or two sentences on who the plan is for.

options.name: features
options.description: What the plan includes; included = false lists one it does not have.

options.name: badge
options.description: A short label beside the name, such as "Recommended".

options.name: highlighted
options.description: Emphasises the card as the recommended plan.

options.name: includedIcon
options.description: A mark before every included feature, such as a check icon. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: currentPlanLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in badge text "Current plan" (monarch_plancard_current).

options.name: notIncludedLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken prefix "Not included:" (monarch_plancard_not_included).

options.name: action
options.description: The call to action, normally one MonarchButton.

states.name: default
states.description: A MonarchCard with the default border and a subtle badge.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: A 2dp accent border, the raised surface with a shadow, and a solid badge.

states.name: current
states.description: An outline badge with "Current plan" beside the name.

appearance: The card is a MonarchCard: the surface color with the default border, or the raised surface with a shadow and a 2dp accent solid border when highlighted. Included features are default text, features that are not included are muted with a dash, and the price period, price note, hints and footer are muted. The included mark is tinted success strong. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web card takes any node for the name, price, features and footer and a heading level; here they are strings, the action is a slot, and the name is always a heading, as on iOS. The web badge on a highlighted card uses the accent tone; MonarchBadge has no accent tone, so it is a solid neutral badge, as on iOS. The web draws a check before included features; Monarch bundles no icons, so the check is the includedIcon slot, and a feature that is not included always shows a dash and is read with "Not included:". As on the web the action follows the description. An app that sells digital goods must use Google Play Billing for the purchase itself.
accessibility: The name is a heading, and the features label is a heading too.
The price and its period are read as one element.
Each feature is one element. A feature that is not included is read with "Not included:" before it and shows a dash, so the difference does not depend on color.
A feature's hint is read after its label.
The action stays a separate element with its own touch target.
Highlighting is a wider border and a badge with text, not color alone.
All text wraps and is not cut off at font scale 2.0; the name and badges flow onto more lines when they do not fit, and the badges follow the name in both layout directions.
edgeCases: Only the name is required; every other part is left out when it is null or empty.
A price without a period, and a period without a price, are both drawn.
The card fills the available width, like a full-width MonarchCard.

examples.title: Placeholder price and features
examples.template:
MonarchPlanCard(
    name = {{name}},
    price = {{price}},
    period = {{period}},
    priceNote = {{priceNote}},
    description = {{description}},
    featuresLabel = {{featuresLabel}},
    features = listOf(
        MonarchPlanCardFeature({{features.0.label}}),
        MonarchPlanCardFeature({{features.1.label}}, hint = {{features.1.hint}}),
        MonarchPlanCardFeature({{features.2.label}}, included = {{features.2.included}}),
    ),
    badge = {{badge}},
    highlighted = {{highlighted}},
) {
    MonarchButton(
        text = {{action.label}},
        onClick = { chosen = {{name}} },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{action.variant|pascal}},
        size = MonarchButtonSize.{{action.size|pascal}},
    )
}
examples.code:
MonarchPlanCard(
    name = "Team",
    price = "₹X",
    period = "/ month",
    priceNote = "Billed monthly",
    description = "For teams that share work every day.",
    featuresLabel = "Everything in Starter, plus",
    features = listOf(
        MonarchPlanCardFeature("Shared projects"),
        MonarchPlanCardFeature("Audit log", hint = "last 90 days"),
        MonarchPlanCardFeature("Single sign-on", included = false),
    ),
    badge = "Recommended",
    highlighted = true,
) {
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Choose Team",
        onClick = { chosen = "Team" },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        size = MonarchButtonSize.Md,
    )
}

examples.title: The current plan
examples.code: MonarchPlanCard(name = "Starter", price = "$0", period = "per month", current = true)
